name: lm-eval Minimal Example
goal: Run lm-evaluation-harness against an existing model artifact via the DataOS eval bridge.
input_description: A ModelArtifact (base or LoRA-tuned). The eval stage does not need a dataset artifact upstream — lm-eval fetches its own task data via Hugging Face datasets.
output_description: A single EvalArtifact whose meta carries per-task results dict, headline_score, and a budget-trimmed copy of the raw lm-eval payload.
